visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short, messy dark hair and sunglasses is biting a large slice of white toast while standing outdoors. Behind her are multi-story residential buildings and parked cars under bright, direct sunlight. (2) She holds a grey metallic device (smartphone/power bank) in front of her face as if checking a reflection or recording, still biting the toast. She then walks toward the glass entrance of a 7-Eleven store. (3) The screen transitions to a mobile interface recording of the ibon Cloud Print website. It demonstrates AI background removal on a photo of a woman, showing various ID photo templates and color options. The woman's own photo—biting the toast—is uploaded and previewed on a blue background. (4) Inside the store, a close-up shows a large multi-function printer. A hand retrieves a freshly printed sheet of glossy photo paper containing eight identical ID-sized photos of the woman biting the toast. (5) A hand-drawn resume titled '履歷表' is shown on a wooden table. One of the 'toast photos' is glued into the portrait box. The hand fills out text fields with a black marker. (6) A close-up of a long-haired grey and white cat with a pink collar is shown; it looks directly at the camera with a grumpy expression. (7) The woman holds up her completed resume to her chest, looking intensely into the camera with a determined expression. (8) The woman is crouched on a tiled floor, wearing a striped shirt and shorts. She is using a plastic scoop to shovel cat litter into a clear plastic bag from a green litter box, smiling at the camera. (9) A close-up shows two printed sheets of ID photos, but these feature the grumpy cat and another black-and-white cat instead of the woman.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo electronic BGM featuring a strong 4/4 beat. A female voice speaks rapidly in Traditional Chinese with high energy and an exaggerated comedic tone. Occasional subtle wind noise suggests an outdoor setting. (2) A mechanical 'whirr' and 'beep' sound effect plays as the visual shifts to the screen recording, followed by digital UI 'tap' sounds. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) A distinct mechanical whirring sound of a high-speed laser printer/copier dominates for three seconds, partially ducking the BGM. (4) The BGM shifts to a more whimsical, bass-heavy 'meme' style track with a syncopated rhythm. The narrator's voice becomes even more theatrical, ending with a loud 'Thank you, boss!' shout. (5) Clear, scratchy, high-frequency SFX of dry grains rubbing together (cat litter) occurs repeatedly. The narrator maintains a cheerful, instructional commentary. (6) A sharp camera shutter 'click' sound marks the final frame where photos are shown, as the BGM fades out abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous narrative about job hunting to promote 7-Eleven's ibon AI-powered ID photo printing service. The protagonist pretends to apply for a job with a 'hairy boss' (revealed to be her cat), showing how easy it is to create and print photos for a resume using the ibon website and store printer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed step-by-step demonstration of using the ibon website, app mentions, and in-store printing hardware.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively blends social media meme culture (the 'bread biting' trope and 'cat as boss') with a practical product demonstration.
